name: SendGrid
description: Typed bounded SendGrid mail, scheduled batches, templates, contacts, lists, segments, suppressions, verified senders, statistics and address validation.

permissions.description: Fixed official SendGrid v3 global/EU HTTPS endpoints with externally supplied restricted API keys. Explicit confirmation for mutations and paid validation; no retries, auto pagination, webhooks, remote attachments or inbox access. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.description: SendGrid Get Contact Import Status
definitions.documentation: SendGrid Get Contact Import Status: one GET /v3/marketing/contacts/imports/{job_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.name: SendGrid Send Mail (Direct)
definitions.description: SendGrid Send Mail
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Send Mail: one POST /v3/mail/send. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID MAIL-SEND. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Create Mail Batch ID: one POST /v3/mail/batch. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID BATCH-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/cancel-scheduled-sends https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates-versions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/contacts https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/lists https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/segmenting-contacts-v2 https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-global-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-unsubscribe-groups https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/bounces-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/blocks-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/invalid-emails-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/spam-reports-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/sender-verification/get-all-verified-senders https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/stats/retrieve-global-email-statistics https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/email-address-validation/validate-an-email https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/api-key-permissions/retrieve-a-list-of-scopes-for-which-this-user-has-access

definitions.description: SendGrid List Paused or Cancelled Batches
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Paused or Cancelled Batches: one GET /v3/user/scheduled_sends. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.name: SendGrid Pause or Cancel Scheduled Batch (Direct)
definitions.description: SendGrid Pause or Cancel Scheduled Batch
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Pause or Cancel Scheduled Batch: one POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID SCHEDULED-PAUSE-CANCEL. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Update Batch Pause or Cancellation
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Update Batch Pause or Cancellation: one PATCH /v3/user/scheduled_sends/{batch_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID SCHEDULED-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.name: SendGrid List Templates (Direct)
definitions.description: SendGrid List Templates
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Templates: one GET /v3/templates. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Get Template
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Template: one GET /v3/templates/{template_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/cancel-scheduled-sends https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates-versions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/contacts https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/lists https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/segmenting-contacts-v2 https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-global-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-unsubscribe-groups https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/bounces-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/blocks-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/invalid-emails-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/spam-reports-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/sender-verification/get-all-verified-senders https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/stats/retrieve-global-email-statistics https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/email-address-validation/validate-an-email https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/api-key-permissions/retrieve-a-list-of-scopes-for-which-this-user-has-access

definitions.description: SendGrid Create Template
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Create Template: one POST /v3/templates. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID TEMPLATES-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/cancel-scheduled-sends https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates-versions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/contacts https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/lists https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/segmenting-contacts-v2 https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-global-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-unsubscribe-groups https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/bounces-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/blocks-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/invalid-emails-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/spam-reports-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/sender-verification/get-all-verified-senders https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/stats/retrieve-global-email-statistics https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/email-address-validation/validate-an-email https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/api-key-permissions/retrieve-a-list-of-scopes-for-which-this-user-has-access

definitions.description: SendGrid Rename Template
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Rename Template: one PATCH /v3/templates/{template_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID TEMPLATES-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/cancel-scheduled-sends https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates-versions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/contacts https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/lists https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/segmenting-contacts-v2 https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-global-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-unsubscribe-groups https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/bounces-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/blocks-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/invalid-emails-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/spam-reports-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/sender-verification/get-all-verified-senders https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/stats/retrieve-global-email-statistics https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/email-address-validation/validate-an-email https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/api-key-permissions/retrieve-a-list-of-scopes-for-which-this-user-has-access

definitions.description: SendGrid Delete Template
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Delete Template: one DELETE /v3/templates/{template_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID TEMPLATES-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/cancel-scheduled-sends https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/transactional-templates-versions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/contacts https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/lists https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/segmenting-contacts-v2 https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-global-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-suppressions https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/suppressions-unsubscribe-groups https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/bounces-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/blocks-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/invalid-emails-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/spam-reports-api https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/sender-verification/get-all-verified-senders https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/stats/retrieve-global-email-statistics https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/email-address-validation/validate-an-email https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/api-key-permissions/retrieve-a-list-of-scopes-for-which-this-user-has-access

definitions.description: SendGrid Create Template Version
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Create Template Version: one POST /v3/templates/{template_id}/versions. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID VERSIONS-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Template Version: one GET /v3/templates/{template_id}/versions/{version_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Edit Template Version: one PATCH /v3/templates/{template_id}/versions/{version_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID VERSIONS-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Activate Template Version: one POST /v3/templates/{template_id}/versions/{version_id}/activate. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID VERSIONS-ACTIVATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Delete Template Version: one DELETE /v3/templates/{template_id}/versions/{version_id}. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID VERSIONS-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Get Sample Contacts
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Sample Contacts: one GET /v3/marketing/contacts. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Contact: one GET /v3/marketing/contacts/{contact_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Add or Update Contacts: one PUT /v3/marketing/contacts. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID CONTACTS-UPSERT. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Delete Selected Contacts: one DELETE /v3/marketing/contacts. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID CONTACTS-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. definitions.description: SendGrid List Contact Lists
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Contact Lists: one GET /v3/marketing/lists. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Contact List: one GET /v3/marketing/lists/{list_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get List Contact Count: one GET /v3/marketing/lists/{list_id}/contacts/count. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Create Contact List: one POST /v3/marketing/lists. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID LISTS-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Rename Contact List
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Rename Contact List: one PATCH /v3/marketing/lists/{list_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID LISTS-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Remove Contacts from List: one DELETE /v3/marketing/lists/{list_id}/contacts. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID LISTS-REMOVE-CONTACTS. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Delete List Keeping Contacts: one DELETE /v3/marketing/lists/{list_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID LISTS-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid List Segments V2
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Segments V2: one GET /v3/marketing/segments/2.0. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Get Segment V2: one GET /v3/marketing/segments/2.0/{segment_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Create Segment V2: one POST /v3/marketing/segments/2.0. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID SEGMENTS-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Update Segment V2
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Update Segment V2: one PATCH /v3/marketing/segments/2.0/{segment_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID SEGMENTS-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Delete Segment V2
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Delete Segment V2: one DELETE /v3/marketing/segments/2.0/{segment_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID SEGMENTS-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid List Unsubscribe Groups
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Unsubscribe Groups: one GET /v3/asm/groups. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Get Unsubscribe Group
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Unsubscribe Group: one GET /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Create Unsubscribe Group: one POST /v3/asm/groups. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID GROUPS-CREATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Update Unsubscribe Group: one PATCH /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID GROUPS-UPDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Delete Unsubscribe Group: one DELETE /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID GROUPS-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Search Group Suppressions
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Search Group Suppressions: one POST /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}/suppressions/search. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Remove Group Suppression: one DELETE /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}/suppressions/{email}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID GROUP-SUPPRESSIONS-DELETE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Add Global Suppressions: one POST /v3/asm/suppressions/global. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID GLOBAL-SUPPRESSIONS-ADD. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Get Global Suppression: one GET /v3/asm/suppressions/global/{email}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get bounces for Address: one GET /v3/suppression/bounces/{email}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.name: SendGrid List blocks (Direct)
definitions.description: SendGrid List blocks
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List blocks: one GET /v3/suppression/blocks. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get blocks for Address: one GET /v3/suppression/blocks/{email}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid List spam reports
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List spam reports: one GET /v3/suppression/spam_reports. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Get spam reports for Address: one GET /v3/suppression/spam_reports/{email}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List invalid emails: one GET /v3/suppression/invalid_emails. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. SendGrid Get invalid emails for Address: one GET /v3/suppression/invalid_emails/{email}. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid List unsubscribes
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List unsubscribes: one GET /v3/suppression/unsubscribes. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Verified Sender Metadata: one GET /v3/verified_senders. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization.
