definitions.name: SendGrid List Available API Scopes (Direct)
definitions.description: SendGrid List Available API Scopes
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid List Available API Scopes: one GET /v3/scopes. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Get Global Email Statistics
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Get Global Email Statistics: one GET /v3/stats. Fixed api.sendgrid.com or documented api.eu.sendgrid.com via region. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.description: SendGrid Validate Email Address
definitions.documentation:
SendGrid Validate Email Address: one POST /v3/validations/email. Global api.sendgrid.com only; EU selection rejected. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SENDGRID EMAIL-VALIDATE. External restricted API key in RuntimeConnection.credentials.apiKey with connection.config, or SENDGRID_API_KEY / explicit secretName. No key creation, arbitrary host, automatic retry, pagination or replay; numeric $retries=0 only. Total Date.now deadline begins before profile/secret lookup and includes stream, decode, projection and cleanup. Default 10s, 100–30000ms bounds. 512KiB request, 1MiB response, 100 rows (contact samples/search 50), depth30, 100000 JSON values, 16384 nonempty fragments; empty chunks ignored. Strict UTF16, fatal UTF8. Named schemas select known fields; omit private provider error bodies. Exact IDs/addresses and null/false/zero/empty preserved where declared. HTTP202 means accepted/queued, never delivered or completed; sandbox200 accepted=false. Mail caps 50 personalizations/100 total recipients/10 canonical-base64 attachments/256KiB attachment bytes; no fetching attachment URLs. No suppression bypass, webhook/listener, inbox, OAuth/refresh, background polling or live-provider proof. Marketing import job status requires an explicit later read. List deletion keeps contacts; removing suppressions can permit future mail and requires deliberate authorization. definitions.name: SendGrid Email Delivery Changed (Relay) Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by SendGrid Email Delivery Changed (Relay).
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for SendGrid Email Delivery Changed (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 sendgrid envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Enable Signed Event Webhook and verify ECDSA signature over exact timestamp plus raw bytes with the configured public key; enforce timestamp/replay policy. OAuth verification, when configured, must be validated by the relay as well. Mapping: Split the verified JSON array into individual events. Map sg_event_id, event, timestamp, sg_message_id and category. Omit recipient email, IP, URL and user-agent. Prefix canonical event types with email.; resource reason is an optional bounded error category only. Canonical eventType values: email.processed, email.delivered, email.deferred, email.bounce, email.dropped. Required envelope: version=1, provider=sendgrid, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Click/open events are provider observations, not proof of a human action. Relay must split batched deliveries and retain each event durably; ECDSA is unsupported by native ingress. Sources: https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/for-developers/tracking-events/getting-started-event-webhook-security-features https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/for-developers/tracking-events/event

setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Enable Signed Event Webhook and verify ECDSA signature over exact timestamp plus raw bytes with the configured public key; enforce timestamp/replay policy. OAuth verification, when configured, must be validated by the relay as well.

Split the verified JSON array into individual events. Map sg_event_id, event, timestamp, sg_message_id and category. Omit recipient email, IP, URL and user-agent. Prefix canonical event types with email.; resource reason is an optional bounded error category only.
